correctness.rationale: Proved analytically using the unital norm-one averaging functional and its representing probability measure; three preimages force the exact 4/3 measure-variation estimate. The canonical E** decomposition follows from regular-measure bands with central C*-algebra summands; the remainder is nonreflexive because it contains isometric c0, so its bidual spectrum has a nontrivial fiber, giving three points in the full spectrum map. Restriction transfers the norm lower bound to the tower, and canonical adjoint retractions explicitly construct a norm-one projection. All infinite cardinalities, inclusions, normalization and quantifiers are covered.

The prior M-projection exclusion does not logically exclude bicontractive projections. Tower construction and general positive projection theory do not themselves identify the extra two lifts of the Stone-Cech remainder point. Targeted literature/index/ledger comparisons located no stronger covering result, but unindexed implications remain possible.
